scope: Typing does not stop visibility/authority checks; ordinary responses wait behind an explicit banner, authority changes prune invalid drafts.
An uncertain mutation remains memory-only and blocks additional mutations; owned receipt GET or explicit identical retry recovers without a new UUID.

limitations: Synthetic local identities only; actual central login/adult verification, physical devices, satisfaction and production operation remain unverified.
Visible idle-request tabs poll every12seconds; hidden tabs and executing actions do not poll. This is not guaranteed push delivery.
Drafts and pending envelopes are tab memory only and disappear on full page reload/tab closure.
Central deletion-requested/restricted candidate-visibility propagation is still a separate next task; final-deletion delivery remains disabled in production.
Paid AI, paid evaluation, tutor and participant recruitment remain deferred.
